message: The other day, I found myself chuckling as I sorted through my go-bags. I realized I might be the gloriously over-prepared person in my circle. I mean, who else has three flashlights, a multi-tool, and enough snacks to keep a small army fueled? 😄 While my family teases me, I secretly love knowing that we're ready for anything—big or small. It’s all about peace of mind, right? What’s your favorite go-bag must-have?
